scientific_reason: Strengthen the independent candidate-only territorial review after the blinding incident by adding only preincident frozen candidate geometry fingerprints and bounding boxes, while preserving the already-frozen candidate membership and matching. No candidate replacement, rematching or target unblind is permitted.

institutional_location_caveat.interpretation: Records whose published coordinates identify only the registering jurisdiction rather than the event site are corroborative only and cannot alone establish a candidate-specific outcome.

fail_closed: geometry fingerprint file hash differs from the frozen value
reviewer bundle hash differs from the preregistered value
candidate membership differs from the frozen seven-code set
any target identifier or A6680 token enters the candidate-only bundle
any target outcome, contaminated-stage material, matching feedback or post-anchor predictor enters the candidate-only bundle
jurisdiction-only evidence is treated as sufficient for a decisive candidate label
